answer: Every epoch a head must file a sonnet of fourteen lines, one line per real person it serves for the first and only time, and the registry strikes each line in saffron so no face is ever helped twice. Every line is an anchor naming a stranger with a live need who has never been served by any agent, and the ledger of who was helped is permanent. The scarce input is that stranger, not money: it cannot be lent to a sibling head, so a farm's tenth head needs a hundred forty more, and the pool of never-served people drains as it is used.
